entries.title: Fewer short pauses each minute with Automation rules or the Heartbeat on
entries.body: Once a minute the app checks your Automation rules, and with the Heartbeat on it also reads your waiting work. To find each rule's event, that check read every connection once for each rule, and it repeated slow preparation for each waiting task, so the window could pause briefly every minute. It now finds every rule's event from one reading of your connections and reuses that preparation, so the check is much shorter.
entries.noPicture: The fix changes how long a background check takes, not how any view looks.
entries.noDocsSite: No docs site page describes how long the minute check takes.
